thread.title: Dow Gains 110 Points as Market Waits for Apple, Payrolls

author: Barron's
title: Dow Gains 110 Points as Market Waits for Apple, Payrolls
text:
Michael Haddad 6:24 a.m. The Dow is trying to start November the way it ended October -with some still elusive gains.
S&P 500 futures have risen 0.4%, while Dow Jones Industrial Average futures have gained 110 points, or 0.4%. Nasdaq Composite futures have advanced 0.3%.
And why shouldn't they? Facebook's ( FB ) earnings after Tuesday's close convinced at least some investors that it was safe to go back in the tech water, while Wednesday's ADP report suggested that the U.S. economy was still strong. Those, however, were just the appetizers for the main course: Apple's ( AAPL ) earnings after Thursday's close and Friday's nonfarm payrolls release. Both could confirm what we saw-or cause investors to start selling once again. "[Solid] ADP employment data helped calm investors' nerves propelling the major indices upwards," writes Konstantinos Anthis , head of research at ADSS . "We expect this rebound to extend until tomorrow's NFPs report and depending on how this prints we may see a further continuation or a reversal lower again."
But at least we can enjoy today.
